title: Moxie Magnet Moon
description: Endless magnetic survival! Moxie dashes with A, pulling in scrap and clearing nearby dust. B fires a stationary pulse. Each 20-second wave brings quicker hunters and aimed comet shots. Keep moving and time your recharge. Four hearts. F fullscreen. Windows installer available. Clean gameplay HUD; deep sea cosmos art direction.
